messages.InstallerReadme:
PulseDeck 2.8.1
===============

Before upgrading, back up music, data including hidden files, and %APPDATA%\PulseDeck

For existing installations, music and data stay in place; storage.json records their paths. Settings and additional languages are kept in the Windows profile, separately from program files

Language: Settings → Application language. “Open languages folder” opens user JSON catalogs; flags are in languages/icons. Fallback: selected language → en.json → key

Online import is for content you have permission to save. Lyrics search sends the title and artist only on your command, not audio. ZIP export contains an unencrypted audio copy and is not uploaded automatically

Protected playlists and their lyrics are encrypted, including hidden folders. Keep passwords and backups safe

FFmpeg, FFprobe and yt-dlp are available in Updates. The repository and update key are not configured yet

First-time setup may need internet access. The installer and game helper are not Authenticode-signed; Windows may show a warning. Setup does not disable protection
